module.title: Windows application and server-role checks
module.description: Checks for Windows applications and server roles: IIS, Remote Desktop Services, and NPS authentication, accounting and performance counters.
module.name: CheckWindowsApps

commands.check_nps_auth: Check NPS authentication outcomes, rejection percentages and reason codes over a time window.
commands.check_nps_accounting: Check discarded NPS accounting requests and optional accounting log freshness.
commands.check_nps_counters: Check the installed NPS/RADIUS performance counters using two samples.
commands.check_iis_app_pools: Check IIS application pools (state, uptime, recycles).
commands.check_iis_sites: Check IIS web sites (state, connections, traffic).
commands.check_iis_worker_processes: Check IIS worker processes (active and served requests per w3wp).
commands.check_iis_request_queues: Check HTTP.sys request queues (length, rejections, age).
commands.check_rds_licenses: Check Remote Desktop licensing (CAL key packs: issued versus available licenses).
commands.check_rds_sessions: Check session counts on a session host (active, inactive, total).
commands.check_rds_session_load: Check per-session resource usage (CPU, working set, protocol bytes).
commands.check_rds_broker: Check the Remote Desktop Connection Broker counterset (failed/pending connections).
